overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation in the subcommittee's January 16 executive session for litigation strategy, but recommended amending its under-detailed executive session minutes.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the subcommittee entered executive session on January 16 for an improper purpose, arguing it lacked authority to initiate litigation.
allegations.key_passage: As such, we find that it was appropriate for the Subcommittee to convene in executive session under Purpose 3 to discuss litigation strategy.

allegations.summary: Not raised in the complaint; the AG noted on its own that the January 16 executive session minutes lack sufficient detail.
allegations.key_passage: Based on our in camera review of the minutes of the Subcommittee's January 16 executive session, we note that the minutes are inadequate to meet the standard required by the Open Meeting Law because they do not offer a sufficiently detailed summary of the Subcommittee's forty-five minute discussion.

remedy: Amend the January 16 executive session minutes to meet the requirements of G.L. c. 30A, § 22(a).
Publicly release the January 16 executive session minutes once publication would no longer defeat the purpose for the executive session.
remedy_passage: We recommend that the Subcommittee amend its January 16 executive session meeting minutes in accordance with the requirements of G.L. c. 3OA, § 22(a).
